description_en: Retrieves execution records of scheduled tasks
description_zh: 获取定时任务执行记录
name: GetScheduledTaskExecutionRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration group (such as cg_101). If specified, a group space task is created and the caller must be a valid group member. If left empty, a personal task is created
parameters.help_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id
